title: Auto satin turns a 90° bend as PE-DESIGN does (Half Stitch on)
description: A 5 mm band bent through 90° in satin with Auto direction, density 3, without under sewing and with Half Stitch on (PE-DESIGN's default for the drawing tools): the rung direction turns with the distance along the outer edge, as in PE-DESIGN's file. OpenStitch does not model Half Stitch; PE-DESIGN's count differs from the -nohalf twin by a few stitches.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference stitches/satin-auto-bend-90.pes (pe-refs-3, 2026-10-28): 219 stitches with Half Stitch on

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page draw the closed polygon (0,0) (30,0) (30,30) (25,30) (25,5) (0,5) mm. Line Not Sewn; region Satin Stitch, Direction Auto, Half Stitch on, Density 3.0, Under Sewing off, other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-auto-bend-90-nohalf.pes (under sewing off, density 3, 2026-10-27): the longest crossings are in the corner fan.
